# Arabian Access (أريبيان أكسس) — Business Setup Consultants in Saudi Arabia

> Arabian Access Management Consultants is a management consultancy in Al Malaz, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specialising in business setup and company formation for local and international clients: entrepreneurs, startups, established companies and foreign investors.

## Key facts
- Name: Arabian Access / Arabian Access Management Consultants / أريبيان أكسس
- Address: Al Malaz Akaria Building, Tower 1, Building No. 6567, Salah Al Din Al Ayoubi Rd, Az Zahra, Riyadh 12812 (Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7543374151440891961)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +966550049513 — https://wa.me/966550049513
- Email: support@arabianaccess.com
- Hours: Saturday–Thursday 9:00–19:00 (Asia/Riyadh); Friday closed
- Consultation: free business consultation; online appointments, at the Riyadh office, or on-site
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/arabian-access/ · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/arabian_access/ · X: https://x.com/ArabianAccess

## Services
- Business Setup & Incorporation (تأسيس الأعمال والتسجيل): Start your business in Saudi Arabia with ease. We handle everything from trade name registration to legal documentation, for a smooth launch.
- Premium Residency (الإقامة المميزة): Premium Residency assistance for entrepreneurs and investors, unlocking ownership, mobility and investment rights in Saudi Arabia.
- Industrial & Operational License (الترخيص الصناعي والتشغيلي): Get your industrial or operational licence approved. We simplify every step for your manufacturing or commercial venture.
- Accounting & Bookkeeping (المحاسبة ومسك الدفاتر): Expert accounting and bookkeeping that keeps you organised and compliant with Saudi regulations.
- VAT & Zakat Support (ضريبة القيمة المضافة والزكاة): We manage your VAT filings and Zakat obligations accurately and on time, so you can focus on growth.
- Audit Support (دعم التدقيق): Financial transparency: we prepare, review and guide you through every compliance requirement.
- PRO / GRO Services (الخدمات الحكومية PRO/GRO): We handle government relations as smoothly as possible, from visa processing to employee documentation.
- Baladiya Registration (تسجيل البلدية): Municipality registration done quickly and correctly, so you operate legally in the Kingdom.
- Trademark Registration (تسجيل العلامة التجارية): Protect your brand identity with professional registration for exclusive rights and long-term security.

## How they work
1. Discovery & planning — We begin with your goals: market entry, growth stage, workforce requirements and organisational structure.
2. Setup & compliance — Legal registration, licence procurement, and initial HR and staffing setup.
3. Launch & operate — You start operations. We continue with administrative support, operational oversight and ongoing staffing solutions.
